name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
about: Apollo, established in 1972, manufactures automatic bias and radial tyres, and tubes. It has plants in Kochi, Vadodara, Pune, and Chennai. The product profile includes prominent tyre brands in the T&B, light truck, passenger car, and farm vehicle segments in India, catering to both original equipment manufacturers, and the replacement market. [1]
keyPoints: Market Position[1] The company is one of India's largest tyre manufacturers by revenue, holding a prominent position in the domestic truck and bus radial, truck and bus bias, and passenger car radial tyre segments, and is among the top 3 players in PCR and the 2nd-largest in TBR by market share.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.6% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 26.1%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.6% over last 3 years.
